"

Drax the Destroyer emerged from the shadows, his massive frame blocking what little light reached the canyon.
As Peter and Gamora approached the temple entrance, Peter glanced at her.

"Yeah, but admit it—life's never boring with us, is it?"

Drax let out a joyful roar as he charged toward the first group of Nova Corps officers.
Peter and Gamora fought back to back, their movements perfectly synchronized despite their constant bickering.

But it worked great!"

Drax was having the time of his life, laughing as he disarmed Nova Corps officers with precise, non-lethal strikes.
